name: MT200 Standard (red, 40 MHz)
source: From SymPhoTime 64 2.8's Standard.pus on the MT200 PC FK03-PC-PC118 (desktop shortcut, 2026-10-28). Sync divider: not in the .pus; at the 40 MHz sync the HydraHarp 400 needs at least 4 (measured). Detectors on HydraHarp inputs 1 and 3 (phacq inputs 0 and 2). TCSPC settings are the same in every MT200 profile: 32 ps bins (binning 5, as in the PIE profiles), sync CFD 350 mV / offset 5000 ps, detectors 250 mV with their offsets (input 0: +130 ps from PIE.pus, input 2: -40 ps from Standard.pus).

som_recorded.note: The SOM 828-D programme read from the unit on 2026-10-28 while this profile was in use. Kept for reference; applied once phacq drives the SOM-D (libphacq docs/sepia_somd.md).

power_diode.note: raw 234 at 47 % red (CAN, 2026-10-28); SymPhoTime showed 189.5 a.u. there (UsrPowerDiode): the a.u. scale is not calibrated yet

shutters.note: MT200 shutter box on the PEAK PCAN-PCIe card (libphacq docs/mt200_shutter.md); Det 3 and Det 4 are not fitted. The box's own buttons override software control.
